name: Snare Genius (Gremlin)
text:
Plenty of gremlins are good at setting traps. You, however, are exceptionally good at it. If a snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead. Each day during your daily preparations, you can prepare three snares from formulas you know for quick deployment (increasing to four snares if you're a master in Crafting and five if you're legendary). Snares prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft.

When a creature critically fails its saving throw against and takes damage from the initial effect of a snare you Crafted and deployed, that creature is Off-Guard until the end of its next turn.
